personality_traits: Curious and loves discovering ancient lore
Sometimes lost in thought or books
ideals: Knowledge is the path to understanding and peace
bonds: I seek the lost spellbook of my mentor who disappeared mysteriously
flaws: I sometimes underestimate physical threats while focused on magical solutions
voice_style: Eloquent, thoughtful, uses arcane terminology, speaks with measured wisdom
combat_style: Ranged spell attacks, area control, defensive positioning, sculpts spells to protect allies
special_abilities: Sculpt Spells (protect allies from AOE damage)
Arcane Recovery (recover spell slots on short rest)
spellbook: Cantrips: Fire Bolt, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation, Light
1st Level: Magic Missile, Shield, Detect Magic, Identify, Mage Armor
2nd Level: Scorching Ray, Misty Step, Detect Thoughts
inventory: Research notes on mentor's last expedition
backstory: Trained at the prestigious Arcane Academy of Silverymoon under the renowned wizard Aldric Stormweaver. Mentor vanished mysteriously during an expedition to ancient elven ruins five years ago. Now seeks both forbidden knowledge and answers about the disappearance. Believes dark magic or an ancient curse may be involved.
current_goals: Research ancient magical artifacts and ruins
Document magical discoveries for future generations
Decode the ancient tome found in mentor's study

distrusted: Those who hoard or destroy knowledge

role_in_party: Knowledge expert and magical artillery. Provides arcane identification, research capabilities, and devastating spell damage. Problem solver through magical means. Often asks questions to gather information before acting.
